stem: The value of \(2x - 1\) is at least 5 and at most 15. Which of the following gives all possible values of \(x\)?
solution: Divide all three parts by 2: \(3 \le x \le 8\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. "At least" and "at most" include the end values, so 3 and 8 are possible values of \(x\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. This gives the possible values of \(2x\); the division by 2 was skipped.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This subtracts 1 from each part instead of adding 1, which gives \(4 \le 2x \le 14\).
